title: rumohra carvifolia
intro: Rumohra carvifolia, commonly known as the Lady Palm or Lady Fern, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Rumohra carvifolia include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-bacterial properties.
